newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Omico readies six real estate projects.
newsitem.headline: Omico readies six real estate projects.

text.p: Omico Corp said on Friday it was planning to develop six real estate properties in different municipalities in northern and southern Philippines.
The company told the Philippine Stock Exchange it had bought a property in the hillside resort city of Tagaytay and planned to develop it into an apartment and commercial complex.
It also planned to build an upscale residential village in the mountain resort city of Baguio, the company said.
Low-cost residential and a mid-scale residential villages are also being planned in other parts of northern Philippines.
Omico did not disclose the purchase prices nor the project costs.

It said it had signed two separate contracts with the provincial governments of Nueva Ecija in northern Philippines and Misamis Oriental in southern Mindanao island to build low-cost residential villages for the residents.
Omico has been designated as the financial consultant to design and package municipal bonds to fund the construction of the two projects, it added. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938
